# Vendored dependencies

The `kevast`, `kevast-chrome` and `kevast-encrypt` packages were removed from
the npm registry on 2026-06-16, which broke clean installs. They are vendored
here unchanged so the extension can still be built.

These copies come from the published npm packages (dist only) and are MIT
licensed; the license files are kept next to each package.

| Package | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| `kevast` | https://github.com/kevast/kevast.js @ 134ce8b90be078bf5088fb1637a01f5a24dcc853 |
| `kevast-chrome` | https://github.com/kevast/kevast-chrome.js @ 5488caf59408c62ba7b0b51de461f0a11b1dfc6f |
| `kevast-encrypt` | https://github.com/kevast/kevast-encrypt.js @ 763d61163fb51c5ba26b3cb35ac46671563ca661 |
